v1_0_to_v1_1: quality per-task: math=exact_match, code=pass@1, knowledge=option_match (NO judge); only arenahard uses judge (qwen-max)
latency fields: total_ms/ttft_ms/decode_ms/tokens_per_second/source; paper metric = Phase 2 all-local vLLM; Phase 1 auxiliary only
new utility_scores reserve: 24 frozen (lam,mu) combos, per-query min-max normalized cost/latency, computed at freeze
known_tension_declared: binary GT labels cap accuracy-axis headroom (R2C lesson); compensated by arenahard graded judge + continuous cost/latency axes; judge prompt frozen for optional retro-labeling without schema change

datasets.source: HF openai/gsm8k via hf-mirror (test 1319 + train first 793), sha256 frozen at download

v2_expansion: gsm8k train remainder ~6.7k, mmlupro test_3000 ~2k, bench: mathbench/livecodebench/livemathbench/bbh/gpqa/simpleqa; schema unchanged

utility.formula: utility = final - lam*Cnorm - mu*Tnorm; Cnorm = usd/max_pool_usd_per_query; Tnorm = total_ms/max_pool_total_ms_per_query

latency.phase2_paper_metric: all-local vLLM FP8 batch=1 sequential: TTFT/TPOT/total

validator_two_levels.schema_level: JSON Schema per line; 4 slots; frozen model set; field domains; unique query_id; prompt dedup
validator_two_levels.trainability_level: ok-rate >= 99% of 20000 slots; latency 100%; final label 100%; utility 24 combos; split frozen & disjoint; sha256 manifest match

scale_gates_v1_to_20k: cost-axis Pareto dominance over Best Single on val
